games.headline: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 43 points, hits go-ahead 3-pointer in Thunder's 117-112 win over Cavs
games.desc: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored a season-high 43 points and made a go-ahead 3-pointer with 32.6 seconds remaining as the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Cleveland Cavaliers 117-112 on Monday night in the first of a two-game set.

games.headline: Cade Cunningham scores 33 points to help the Pistons rout the Hornets 124-91
games.desc: — Cade Cunningham scored a season-high 33 points, Duncan Robinson added 24 behind six 3-pointers and the Detroit Pistons beat the Charlotte Hornets 124-91 on Monday night for their third straight victory.

games.headline: Down to 6 players, Jay Huff and Pacers put scare in Hawks before losing 108-104
games.desc: — Jay Huff scored 22 points for Indiana and the Pacers, down to six players because of injuries and rest, put a scare into the Atlanta Hawks before...

games.headline: Knicks break away in fourth quarter and beat the Nets for the 15th straight time, 103-90
games.desc: — Landry Shamet scored a season-high 22 points and the New York Knicks beat the Brooklyn Nets 103-90 on Monday night for their 15th straight victory over their city rival.

games.headline: Anthony Davis, AJ Dybantsa lead Wizards to 103-94 win over Magic
games.desc: — Anthony Davis had 29 points and eight rebounds, AJ Dybantsa added 21 points in his third NBA game and the Washington Wizards beat the Orlando Magic 103-94 Monday night.

games.headline: Maxey, James lead Philadelphia 76ers to 7-1 start with 126-107 victory over Chicago Bulls
games.desc: — Tyrese Maxey scored 15 of his game-high 26 points in the fourth quarter, LeBron James had 15 points, nine assists and seven rebounds, and the Philadelphia 76ers won their fourth in a row, 126-107 over the Chicago Bulls on Monday night.

games.headline: Kings beat the Mavericks 115-100 for their first victory of the season
games.desc: — Rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 25 points and the Sacramento Kings won for the first time in seven games this season, beating the Dallas Mavericks 115-100 on Monday night.

games.headline: Williamson's 25 points, free throws by Fears, give Pelicans 135-134 win over Grizzlies in overtime
games.desc: — Zion Williamson scored 25 points including nine in overtime, Jeremiah Fears hit two free throws with 7.3 seconds left, and the New Orleans Pelicans handed the Memphis Grizzlies their first loss of the season, 135-134 on Monday night.

games.headline: Ball scores season-high 34 points as Timberwolves top Bucks 112-100
games.desc: — LaMelo Ball scored a season-high 34 points to lead six players in double figures and the Minnesota Timberwolves pulled away early in the fourth quarter in a 112-100 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Monday night.

games.headline: Alperen Sengun leads Rockets past Celtics 109-93 as Houston moves into first in West
games.desc: — Alperen Sengun had 26 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds to lead the Houston Rockets to a 109-93 win over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.

games.headline: Harper, Wembanyama lead Spurs past Jazz 119-97, extend winning streak to 5 games
games.desc: — Dylan Harper scored 17 points, Victor Wembanyama added 12 points, 11 rebounds and three blocks and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to their fifth straight victory, topping the Utah Jazz 119-97 on Monday night.

games.headline: Deni Avdija scores 28 points in the Trail Blazers' 118-110 win over the Nuggets
games.desc: — Deni Avdija scored nine of his 28 points in the fourth quarter and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Denver Nuggets 118-110 on Monday night, extending their road winning streak to begin the season.

games.headline: Stephen Curry scores 34 points as Warriors hold off Suns 116-113 in testy game with three technicals
games.desc: — Stephen Curry had 34 points, seven assists and six rebounds, Charles Bassey scored a career-best 19 points to go with eight rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors held off the Phoenix Suns 116-113 in a testy matchup Monday night featuring three...

games.headline: Scottie Barnes rallies Raptors to 125-118 win, handing Clippers their 6th straight defeat
games.desc: — Scottie Barnes scored 15 of his 22 points in the fourth quarter, Immanuel Quickley had 27 and the Toronto Raptors rallied for a 125-118 win over the skidding Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.

games.headline: Luka Doncic scores 42 points in another brilliant game, leading the Lakers past the Heat 138-117
games.desc: — Luka Doncic had 42 points, 13 assists and seven rebounds in another spectacular early-season performance, leading the Los Angeles Lakers to a 138-117 victory over the Miami Heat on Monday night.
